description.zh: 在 Operit 上还原 npm 生态的包管理器：init / search / install / remove / manager / build / verify。build/verify 同时支持 TS 与纯 JS 工程的打包。默认对接辰锤 npm 私有源。
description.en: An npm-like package manager on Operit: init / search / install / remove / manager / build / verify, backed by the Chenchui private npm registry.

description.zh: 【开发工具】适用于 Operit 开发工程的类 npm 包管理工具，提供 init / search / install / remove / manager / build / verify 七个工具
description.en: [Development Tools] A npm-like package management tool for Operit development projects, offering seven commands: init, search, install, remove, manager, build, and verify.
